Definition: adverb from G2078; finally, i.e. (with G2192) at the extremity of life:--point of death.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, eschátōs means finally, that is at the extremity of life. It occurs just once, in Mark.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe eschátōs is best left as Scripture leaves it: finally, that is at the extremity of life.
RelatedEvents: Jairus' Daughter and the Bleeding Woman
